name: three tea api POST creates in one command

item.command:
cd $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/pr && mk(){ jq -n --arg t "$2" --arg b "$(cat $3)" --arg h "$4" '{title:$t, body:$b, head:$h, base:"main"}' > /tmp/pr_$$.json; tea api -X POST repos/wonderlydotcom/$1/pulls -d @/tmp/pr_$$.json | jq -r '.number, .html_url'; rm /tmp/pr_$$.json; }
mk internal-tool-csm-ops "feat(csm-ops): Count CSMs with broken connections and check-ins without transcripts for the roadmap" csm-ops.md feat/csm-connections-count
mk internal-tools-instance "feat(csm-ops): Let the CAMP Eng Roadmap read CSM connection counts" instance.md feat/roadmap-csm-connections-scope
mk internal-tool-camp-eng-roadmap "feat(goals): Read CSM connection health from CSM Ops hourly" roadmap.md feat/csm-connections-goal

name: tea api POST of an issue comment and a PATCH of a pull

item.command:
cd /home/scowalt/.bb/plugins/environment-git-worktree/host-data/worktrees/thr_95kbvf458h-1/internal-tool-people-ops && R=repos/wonderlydotcom/internal-tool-people-ops
c413='Superseded.'
c410='Superseded.'
for pair in "413|$c413" "410|$c410"; do n=${pair%%|*}; body=${pair#*|}; for i in 1 2 3; do out=$(tea api -X POST $R/issues/$n/comments -d "$(jq -nc --arg b "$body" '{body:$b}')" 2>&1) && break; sleep 5; done; echo "$n comment: $(echo "$out" | jq -r '.html_url // .message // .' 2>/dev/null | head -2)"; for i in 1 2 3; do out=$(tea api -X PATCH $R/pulls/$n -d '{"state":"closed"}' 2>&1) && break; sleep 5; done; echo "$n close: $(echo "$out" | jq -r '"state=\(.state) merged=\(.merged)"' 2>/dev/null || echo "$out" | head -3)"; done
